content:
niki: FYI found duplicated side-effects in the Go onboarding sampleapp. Repro is fast: createPayment -> 429 -> client retry (jitter ~50ms) -> token auto-refresh finishes mid-retry -> server records duplicate payment.

niki: repro notes: rapid sign-up + immediate payment. suspect replay/idempotency header lifecycle tied to auth state.

niki: logs: 
```
2026-03-02T09:12:01Z INFO payment request id=req-77 auth=refreshing
2026-03-02T09:12:01Z WARN 429 req=req-77 retry scheduled backoff=48ms
2026-03-02T09:12:01Z INFO auth refreshed for user=77
2026-03-02T09:12:01Z INFO retry req=req-77 header x-rw-replay-id missing -> created duplicate resource
```

ben: thanks. is this only in the Go SDK / CLI consumer?

niki: only seen in Go and a customer CLI report that uses go-lib. Node & Python have different middleware ordering so far unaffected.

ray: sounds like our auth middleware reconstructs requests and loses headers we attach earlier. If replay-id lives on the auth client instance and the instance is replaced on refresh, the retry path can pick up a new request without the original replay header.

tara: concrete fixes: (a) generate x-rw-replay-id at the start of the logical request and store in request context so it survives auth refresh, (b) make it immutable across retries for that logical request, (c) for multipart/stream flows, attach a sequence number (e.g., x-rw-replay-seq) so server can dedupe per-stream.

ben: agree. also add a regression test that fakes token rotation mid-retry and asserts no duplicate side-effects.

niki: quick pseudo for Go patch: 
```
// before any auth ops
rid := ctx.Value("x-rw-replay-id")
if rid == nil { rid = uuid.New().String(); ctx = context.WithValue(ctx, "x-rw-replay-id", rid) }
req.Header.Set("x-rw-replay-id", rid.(string))
// then call auth.Do(ctx, req) which may refresh but will carry ctx
```

ray: does this break reuse across unrelated requests? ensure we scope to logical request lifecycle (created by API call, not by HTTP connection).

tara: short-term mitigation for sampleapp: increase min 429 backoff to 200ms so token refresh window (50-150ms) won't commonly collide. But thats brittle; prefer SDK fix.

ci-bot: created issue DEVEX-4721: cross-sdk replay-id lifecycle + spec.

niki: i'll open PR against go-sdk: (1) attach replay id early in request path, (2) add per-logical-request lifecycle management, (3) unit + integration test that simulates refresh mid-retry. attaching logs and repro harness.

ben: after PR, roll spec to node/python with a tiny doc: header name `x-rw-replay-id`, semantics (per-logical-request, immutable across retries), sequence header for multipart, and recommended jitter/backoff defaults (min 50ms for normal, 200ms for onboarding sampleapp until patched).

ray: also add metric: duplicates_per_100k_requests and a dashboard to compare pre/post rollout. alert if >5 per 100k for payment endpoints.

tara: will update onboarding tutorial and sampleapp defaults once go-sdk PR lands. new hires keep hitting this during evals.

ci-bot: PR niki/replay-id-lifecycle -> ci/presubmit queued (4 checks)

niki: thanks all, opening PR now. ping me for review. :thumbsup:
